name: Transfer
description: A Transfer represents a transaction where funds are moved between two accounts from the company's QuickBooks chart of accounts.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. Required for update.

fields.name: ToAccountRef
fields.description: Identifies the asset account to which funds are transfered. Query the Account name list resource to determine the appropriate Account object. Use Account.Id and Account.Name for ToAccountRef.value and ToAccountRef.name. The specified account must have Account.Classification set to Asset.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Account.Id of the destination asset account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Account.Name of the destination asset account.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Indicates the total amount of the transaction.

fields.name: FromAccountRef
fields.description: Identifies the asset account from which funds are transfered. Query the Account name list resource to determine the appropriate Account object. Use Account.Id and Account.Name for FromAccountRef.value and FromAccountRef.name. The specified account must have Account.Classification set to Asset.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Account.Id of the source asset account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Account.Name of the source asset account.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Incremented on modification. Required for update.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. This note does not appear on the invoice to the customer. Maps to the Memo field on the Invoice form.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. For posting transactions, this is the posting date that affects the financial statements. If not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction. It captures what recurring transaction template the Transfer was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the recurring transaction template.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the recurring transaction template.
